from openpyxl.worksheet.filters import FilterColumn, Filters

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/110-2/1_110-2_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/110-2_0_4450cc45/1_110-2_output.xlsx")
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Apply the AutoFilter to the allowed range only.
filter_range = "A1:C13"
ws.auto_filter.ref = filter_range

# Criteria arrays:
# Array_1 -> Column 1, Array_2 -> Column 2, Array_3 -> Column 3.
# Array_3 is set to the changed example requested: Array("101", "103").
array_1 = ["1", "2"]
array_2 = ["11", "12"]
array_3 = ["101", "103"]

# Clear any existing filter columns and add the three criteria filters.
ws.auto_filter.filterColumn = []
for zero_based_col_id, criteria in enumerate([array_1, array_2, array_3]):
    fc = FilterColumn(colId=zero_based_col_id)
    fc.filters = Filters(filter=criteria)
    ws.auto_filter.filterColumn.append(fc)

# Make the filtered result visible in Excel-compatible form by hiding rows
# that do not meet the intersection of all three filter criteria.
set_1 = set(array_1)
set_2 = set(array_2)
set_3 = set(array_3)

# Ensure all rows in the filtered range start visible, then hide nonmatches.
for r in range(2, 14):
    v1 = str(ws.cell(r, 1).value)
    v2 = str(ws.cell(r, 2).value)
    v3 = str(ws.cell(r, 3).value)
    ws.row_dimensions[r].hidden = not (v1 in set_1 and v2 in set_2 and v3 in set_3)

# Header remains visible.
ws.row_dimensions[1].hidden = False

wb.save(output_path)

# Verification printout: values in A1:C13 and visibility status.
